div.head: II Ew 3.1
div.ab: Gyf he nyte, hwa hine on borh nime, ðonne niman ða ðe hit togebyreð on his æhtan inborh.
Gif he nyte, hwa hine on borh nime, þonne niman þa ðe hit togebyreð on his æhtan inborh.
Si nesciat, quis eum capiat in plegium, accipiant illi, quibus hoc pertinet, de pecunia sua inborhgum.
Gif he nyte, hwa hine on borh nime, þonne niman þa ðe hit togebyreð on his æhtan inborh.
If he knows no one who shall stand surety for him, those concerned may take security from his property.
Wenn er niemanden weiss, der ihn in Bürgschaft nehme, dann sollen diejenigen, denen es zukommt, pfandliche Sicherheit an seinem Vermögen nehmen.
If he knows of no one who will take him into surety, then those to whom it belongs are to take a pledge-security from his property.
